data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 王女寝宫的晨曦真丝卧榻
data.description: 清晨的薄阳洒在王女寝殿柔软的纯白大床上。拉·芙利亚侧躺在雕花丝绸枕席之间，轻薄半透的浅绿真丝睡裙滑落一侧，展现出天鹅般修长的玉颈与优雅锁骨。银白色的长发在被单间如水银般流淌，这位在政坛翻云覆雨的第一王女，此刻眸光泛着动人的晨曦微澜，嘴角带着猫咪般的狡黠与宠溺浅笑。
data.action: lying on side amidst silk pillows in palace bedchamber, sheer green silk slip nightgown, bare shoulders and collarbone,银发 cascading over sheets, teasing tender morning gaze
data.location: luxurious royal bedchamber with sheer curtains and golden morning light
data.lighting: warm pristine morning sunbeams pouring through tall palace arched windows
data.mood: intimate sovereign vulnerability, playful regal morning sweetness
data.promptProse: Reclining on a lavish palace bed in the golden morning light, La Folia wears a sheer silk slip nightgown. Her silver hair flows across white pillows as she looks up with an enigmatic, deeply affectionate gaze.
data.animaCaption: La Folia waking up on a palace bed in a sheer silk slip nightgown, smiling softly.
